topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This topic frames the lecture by introducing its overarching themes on cancer evolution, microenvironmental influences, and key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cell-intrinsic driver mutations and epigenetic chromatin modifications confer selective advantages during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cancer Stem Cells and Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore hierarchical stem cell models and experimental evidence demonstrating how specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Influences, Spatial Profiling, and Cancer Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments promote tumor development, the spatial methods used to analyze these interactions, and an integrative summary of cancer coevolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This topic provides the final closing remarks and previews the topic of the next lecture.
